After Dec versions of TS 36.331 and TS 38.331 are published, the WI running CR Rapporteurs will port the running CRs to the new specification, that is create new running CRs with the new spec as baseline. When porting a running CR to the new specification, it is recommended that the complete specification is kept within the CR (i.e., unchanged parts/sections are not deleted). Then, the overall specification impact of the new Rel-16 feature is easier visualized, and specification quality is easier ensured (e.g. new sections, field and IE names). Unchanged parts of the running CR can be deleted as a late CR Rapporteur activity before CR agreement. It is also recommended that draft running CRs are stored on ftp server, and not circulated in mails on the reflector. ftp://ftp.3gpp.org/Email_Dis

[CR CR4617r1 for 38.331] Reason for change: The CR is to address the issues mentioned by RILs: E079, E106, E114, S651 and N082. Summary of change: In text procedure, to refer to field name ncr-FwdConfig, not IE name NCR-FwdConfig; Add extension markers to NCR-AperiodicFwdTimeResource-r18, NCR-PeriodicFwdResource-r18 and NCR-SemiPersistentFwdResource-r18; Change “Need N” to “setupRelease {}, Need M” for aperiodicFwdConfig-r18 in NCR-FwdConfig-r18. Add missing RAN1 spec references; Remove redundant field descriptions according to RAN2#125 agreements. Consequences if not approved: Wrong reference and need code are used in RRC spec for NCR.

[CR CR4790r1 for 36.331] Reason for change: The changes included in this CR aim to correct minor errors in the specification. Summary of change: This CR includes the following changes: In, 5.3.5.9.4 Conditional reconfiguration evaluation For CHO case, the target cell is included within MobilityControlInfo. Thus, change the ServingCellConfigCommon to MobilityControlInfo. Added missing suffix “-r16” in several instances: In RRCConnectionResume-v1610-IEs and UE-EUTRA-Capability. Suffices “-r16” are removed from the CHOICE structure in RLF-Report-r9 IE. [9] (ran2_cr_chunks 38.331, sim=0.5665)
[CR CR4611r1 for 38.331] Reason for change: During ASN.1 review, companies identified a number of issues in TS 38.331 related to the changes introduced by XR Work Item (see R2-2401695). This CR captures corrections to the issues which were found relevant by RAN2 as well as some editorial changes (class 0 issues from ASN.1 review). Summary of change: The following issues are addressed in this CR, following the agreed RIL resolutions as per R2-2401695: H550, V153, I113, H551, V150, I052, H552, H553, F011, H554, H555, H556, F010, H558, X093, A500, F012, H399. Editorial corrections are introduced to address class 0 issues identified during ASN.1 review. Consequences if not approved: The XR related features are not captured entirely correct in the specifications.

[10] (ran2_cr_chunks 38.305, sim=0.5651)
[CR CR0161 for 38.305] Reason for change: The CR introduces functionality for support of NR positioning enhancements. Summary of change: Add description of procedures for area-specific SRS configuration Consequences if not approved: Missing stage 2 for support of NR positioning enhancements.
